name: OpenDeepWiki
description: OpenDeepWiki is the open-source version of the DeepWiki project, aiming to provide a powerful knowledge management and collaboration platform. The project is mainly developed using C# and TypeScript, supporting modular design, and is easy to expand and customize.
summary: OpenDeepWiki 是 DeepWiki 项目的开源版本，旨在提供强大的知识管理与协作平台。该项目主要采用 C# 和 TypeScript 开发，支持模块化设计，易于扩展与定制
